main.description: A manager's answer to a request to see the private part of a press kit. Written only by the Local Network root account, into the project's computer.localnetwork.space.epkRequests space beside the request. Someone declined can't ask to see that press kit again.

epk.description: The computer.localnetwork.epk record it asked to see.

decidedBy.description: The manager who answered, or the root account when the press kit's rules approved the request.
